description: Opens a menu of actions at the pointer position.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Right-click this button
  • Buttons
  • Trees

Try the contextmenu using its trigger.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector of the element whose context-menu action opens this menu.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Shows the context menu when present; removing it closes the menu.

methods.name: closeAll(): void
methods.description: Collapses all expanded submenus without closing the context-menu container.

methods.name: hide(): void
methods.description: Closes the context menu by clearing its open state.

methods.name: showAt(x: number, y: number): void
methods.description: Opens the context menu at viewport coordinates x and y in CSS pixels.

events.name: tp-contextmenu-select
events.description: Emitted when a terminal menu item with data-action is activated. The detail contains its action identifier, li element and visible label.
events.detail: { action: string; item: HTMLLIElement; label: string }

cssproperties.name: --tp-contextmenu-background
cssproperties.description: Background color of the menu and submenus.

cssproperties.name: --tp-contextmenu-border-color
cssproperties.description: Border color of the menu and dividers.

cssproperties.name: --tp-contextmenu-hover
cssproperties.description: Hover background color for menu items.

cssproperties.name: --tp-contextmenu-submenu-offset
cssproperties.description: Inline offset used to position submenus.

cssproperties.name: --tp-contextmenu-z-index
cssproperties.description: Stacking level of the context menu.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-contextmenu>` element opens a menu of actions at the pointer position.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Open the context menu on its associated area, then choose an available action. |
| Using the component | Dismiss the menu to return to the content without choosing an action. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
